company_profile: OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company whose Applied AI team helps engineering organizations adopt Codex across the software development lifecycle.
title: Applied AI Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years taking ML and LLM systems from prototype to production in enterprise settings across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Builds agentic workflows in LangGraph, tool-using agents and RAG applications, with evaluation harnesses, LLM evaluators, tracing and observability that keep them reliable in production. Works hands-on in Python with FastAPI, Docker and MLflow, and turns client requirements into working prototypes and measurable results. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Agentic Code Review Assistant
bullets: Built a LangGraph agent that reviews pull requests for software teams, calling tools to read diffs, run tests and suggest fixes, with RAG over past review comments.
Evaluated it on representative code-review tasks with automated LLM graders and developer feedback, and served it through FastAPI in Docker with tracing for failure analysis.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Applied AI Engineer role on the Codex team. For the past few years I have built LLM agents that real teams depend on, most recently a lab-extraction agent and a multi-agent analytics chatbot, each with its own evaluation harness. What ties my work together is taking an AI idea past the demo and into daily use.

OpenAI's Applied AI team sits where models meet real engineering organizations, and helping developers change how they plan, write and review code is the kind of adoption work I enjoy most. On the personal side, my fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Paris together and settle there long term.

I would bring hands-on engineering and a habit of measuring things. The evaluation and observability pipelines I built with LLM evaluators and tracing cut human review by 43%, and of the 15+ client prototypes I built at Viavi, 7 reached production or paid work because we agreed on success criteria with the client first.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me honest about building for real users, one careful change at a time. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
